svg.text: How a junction's outline joins each gap
Equal widths: a corner at P on one
A dead end: one gap of 360°,
90° bend: the circle slides by s
until it touches the narrower curb
70° bend: the narrower curb runs on
past the node to the circle
30° bend: the circle rounds off the
Straight: the T–X piece on both
A curving road: the T–X piece is
its curb swung about X, not straight
A road set back further than a gap
asks follows its curb back to P
round, P, T and X are one point
N: the node. P: a corner. T: beside the node on the wider road. X: where the narrower curb crosses the circle about N with the wider road's w/2.
O: the center of a slid circle, s its slide. Thick: where each roadway ends. Dashed: centerlines, and each round join's circle. Dotted: the T–X straight.
